query: UPDATE idempotency SET execution_status = 'cancelled', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id = ANY($1) AND execution_status = 'queued' AND (key LIKE 'team-wake:%' OR key LIKE 'team-start:%' OR key LIKE 'team-round:%') RETURNING conversation_id AS "conversation_id!", key LIKE 'team-start:%' AS "first!"
